machine: sandbox 2 vCPU, rustc 1.99.1, bench profile (thin LTO, codegen-units=1)
fixture: synthetic DOM 10k/2k nodes (depth 12, 8 tags, 64 classes, seed 42), 200 selectors (seed 42)
notes: v0.7 = v0.6 automaton + zero-copy parent-state reads (v0.6 memcpy'd 2*wr*16B per node) + AVX2 transition kernel (2 u128 words per op) + SoA hi-classes CSR + optional direct-mapped (tag,mask)->ok cache (style_pass_cached; loses ~4% on the 30%-repeat fixture, kept for dense real-world vocabularies). BFS level-order banks were tried first and regressed +32% @ 10k (working set O(width) vs O(depth)) - reverted, documented in WORKLOG Iteration 6. New kernels: rustfox-url (zero-copy SIMD parser), rustfox-html (zero-copy tokenizer; wins 1.86x on prose pages, loses 1.37x on token-dense markup where text runs are shorter than the SIMD break-even), rustfox-http1 (zero-copy headers), rustfox-simd (cached feature detection + hybrid length dispatch).
